name: Console Key
summary: The Console Key is a mechanical bypass key held by Tinkerer Sniggles at the Venture Company digsite in the Barrens. It unlocks the main control terminal housing the samophlange, allowing the device to be extracted after the apparatus has been shut down.

sections.title: Securing the Apparatus
sections.body: The Venture Company maintains an extensive industrial outpost in the northern Barrens, reliant on specialized steam-driven machinery regulated by an enigmatic device known as a samophlange. To prevent unauthorized tampering, the apparatus console is locked tight. Only the chief technician on site, Tinkerer Sniggles, carries the Console Key required to pop open the terminal casing and completely cut power to the rig.

sections.title: Shutting Down the Rig
sections.body: Disabling the control console requires more than just brute force. Once the auxiliary valves are manipulated and the internal apparatus is cooled to an idle state, inserting the Console Key cuts the final circuits. Turning the key drains the remaining energy from the terminal, unlocking the housing so the samophlange can be safely pried out of the machinery.

faq.q: What does the Console Key unlock?
faq.answer: It unlocks the main control console at the Venture Company rig in the northern Barrens, exposing the samophlange and draining power from the terminal once the machinery is idling.
The key is kept by Tinkerer Sniggles, a Venture Company engineer stationed in a hut just northeast of the primary console apparatus.

faq.q: Why is the console locked in the first place?
aliases: why do i need a key
faq.answer: The Venture Company operates proprietary and dangerous industrial tech. Locking the terminal prevents meddling rivals or unruly laborers from sabotaging the machinery or extracting valuable components like the samophlange.

faq.q: Can you use the key before shutting down the valves?
faq.answer: The key is designed to unlock the console after the apparatus has been powered down and the gauges read zero. Attempting to tamper with an active console risks total mechanical backfire.

angles.text: The Venture Company uses customized keyed lockouts to safeguard delicate engineering prototypes like the samophlange from competitors.
Taking the Console Key from Tinkerer Sniggles helps disrupt the Venture Company's exploitative industrial operations in the heart of the Barrens.
